why_not: The case series (NCFRP_V51) does not have a direct measure of pre-pregnancy healthcare visits, and PRAMS Phase 8 is biased towards high-risk areas.
rationale: This design cannot establish the rate difference due to missing data on pre-pregnancy health care visits in NCFRP_V51 and potential bias in PRAMS Phase 8.
prior_art: The closest tested work includes limitations related to exposure misclassification (SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C12) and indirect denominator sources (bedsharing_ms_v7.C19), but these do not address pre-pregnancy healthcare visits directly. Therefore, the question remains open due to data gaps.
cannot_establish: Causation; the design only compares proportions of pre-pregnancy health care visits among SUID cases versus live births.
